name: Nexteer Automotive Group Limited
summary: Nexteer Automotive Group Limited, a motion control technology company, develops, manufactures, and supplies steering and driveline systems to original equipment manufacturers in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It offers electric power steering (EPS) products, which include steer-by-wire, rear-wheel steering, rack-assist electric power steering, single and dual pinion-assist EPS, modular EPS, column-assist electric power steering, automated steering actuators, and modular power packs.
